notes.title: Change Log: Patch .01
notes.notes:
Based on some feedback and general house keeping we now have the following:

Full Screen Now available - Press Alt+ Enter. Maintains same resolution but at full screen level - In Testing Phase!
Encounters decreased for intro sequence forest.
Steam Cards, Backgrounds and emoticons have been sent for review so watch this space!
Story progression: A new full scene is now added. 
Finally, the game will now show a message when you have reached the end to what is currently playable. 

More to come in time.

notes.title: Dev live Q&A - If there is enough interest.
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow knights of the Vanir, 

Want to ask a question about the game or it's development and have it answered live?

Such as: How come it's taking soo long? or why is Clarence such a moody so and so in the game? 

Then come along to the live Q&A this Saturday 13th July 1700BST. 

Please register your interest in the comments so I can guage if anyone actually wants to take part! 

Regards, 

Vanburman

P.S I'll post the method the day before Hangouts/Discord etc.

notes.title: Soft Release on Steam!
notes.notes:
Well I finally gave up the ghost on getting this journey finished. 

Hopefully you can enjoy it for what it is, I still maintain that one day it will be finished, but for now this is where we are at. 

I want to thank everyone that has been so faithful and believed in the project, in reality this release is for you and with any luck you'll see it develop. As I mentioned on the store page I missed the boat on early access which I feel would have been more appropriate. 

I have had a couple of messages R.E the current state of the game and will endevour to make it playable in the least. To that end I have today uploaded a patch that fixes a particular bug. Please do inform me of them as and when you find them as it'll be useful to me to squash them.

Thank you once again. 

P.S at some point I hope to do the cards and achievements, but one thing at a time!

notes.title: Greenlight to Steam Store
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, 

Wow it's been a quick transition from Greenlight to Steam after being Greenlit. 

You'll probably most likely notice the long time until release, this is placeholder and subject to change. However I have guessedimated that it will be around then!

Honestly I am over the moon to have the game on Steam, it's like a dream. Just so that I am clear with the vision, No Early Access and hopefully very few updates, I aim to get the game done and dusted before release. 

I hope this accouncement will help outline some of the initial quiries.

Please feel free to start a discussion on the forum :) 

Thank you for reading! 

Regards, 

William Burman a.k.a vanburman
